identity: A lower-primary Arabic worksheet mixing life-skills/manners items with early Islamic-education items — 20 prompts one per layout line: 18 true/false statements (helping mother, playing with knives and fire, leaving the tap running, shouting at parents, all creatures needing God, الصمد among God's names, يوم الدين) and 2 three-option multiple-choice items (@79 'أتناول إفطاري كل …' and @133 'يوم الدين هو يوم …').
law: §J/§S. Each layout line is [statement ‖ صح ‖ خطأ] or [stem ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt]. J6 is the whole law for the true/false lines: the statement and everything qualifying it stay together, and ONLY the answer options split — so the coordinating و of 'الطعام الصحي و المفيد' (@35), 'أبي وأمي' (@17), 'أخي وأختي' (@49), 'أمي وأبي' (@60/@89) and the conditional 'إذا اختلفت مع أخي أقاطعه' (@40-44) are all stem interior. 62 boundaries over 155 tokens = 2.5 tokens/segment.
